setup.architecture: ViT-S/14 hidden 384 layers 12 patch 14 no registers
setup.preprocess_224: native 224 uint8 / 255, ImageNet mean/std, no resize. Official HF processor would upsample shortest edge to 256 then center-crop 224; that resample is skipped because frames are already 224.
setup.preprocess_196: bicubic antialias resize 224 to 196, then the same ImageNet norm. 196/14=14 patches.
setup.position_embedding: config image_size 518, interpolated to the input grid inside Dinov2Embeddings
setup.lewm_note: epoch-1 generalist, CLS and projector, eval mode, 224 ImageNet norm
setup.split: 100 episodes, length>=48, 32 frames each, every 4th episode held out
setup.probe: column-standardized dual ridge, alpha chosen on an inner episode split, refit on all train episodes
setup.spatial_readout: linear ridge on 4x4 and 8x8 average-pooled patch tokens
setup.baselines: train-mean constant, fixed random projection of area-pooled RGB grid

unavailable.reason: train.lance has state (agent xy, block xy, angle, agent vel) and no goal pose.

label_checks.note: distance_to_target matches Euclidean agent-target distance. It is not a wall-aware path length. Door position is observation[4:6].
